g.text: GIRIMĀNANDA — SICK, IN PAIN, GRAVELY ILL
“If you would speak these ten perceptions to him, it is possible that his sickness would immediately subside.”
wrt the five aggregates subject to clinging
wrt the six internal and external sense bases
bounded by skin, full of various impurities
many afflictions arise in this body
thoughts of sensuality, ill will, and harming
“This is peaceful, this is sublime ... fading of desire ... Nibbāna”
etaṁ santaṁ · etaṁ paṇītaṁ · virāgo · nibbānaṁ
“This is peaceful, this is sublime ... cessation ... Nibbāna”
etaṁ santaṁ · etaṁ paṇītaṁ · nirodho · nibbānaṁ
Lack of Desire for All Constructs
horrified, repelled, and disgusted by all constructs
just mindful, he breathes in and out
to be trained in while breathing in-and-out
“Having heard these ten perceptions, an arisen affliction would immediately subside.”
dasa saññā sutvā so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi

svg.text: Seeing things as they are · Reviewing this body · Giving up
Inclining toward peace · Turning away · Mindfulness while breathing
